title: Gateway key: last-known-good cache for locked-screen misses
intent: Agents in flight keep working when the screen locks: gateway.keyCommand serves a 0600 last-known-good cache when the Secure Enclave lookup misses, while secretspec stays the source of truth
proof_hooks: miss with cache present returns the cached key in under 1 s with exit 0
miss without cache keeps 6 attempts and surfaces the error
success writes the cache 0600 only on change
